quote.author: Dan Devine
quote.text: People say they're about this game-watching life, but are they talking about Nolan Traore scoring nine points in a quarter, blasting through the teeth of the Celtics' defense with a strong left-hand drive? No. They probably have something else going on. Pretty understandable.

items.title: I've been writing about this in the first week of the season: Keep an eye on Chaney Johnson as an eventual conversion to a standard deal.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
I've been writing about this in the first week of the season: Keep an eye on Chaney Johnson as an eventual conversion to a standard deal.

He's a good defender, rebounder and his shot is much improved. Good player and should outplay his two-way deal.
